items.requirement: System MUST maintain an inventory of every Echelon initiative with accountable owner and campaign eligibility.
items.acceptance: A newly added initiative is discoverable with owner, status, and last review; unassessed initiatives are marked unassessed.

items.requirement: Every initiative MUST link to at least one explicit customer-problem hypothesis or have a documented no-market-campaign decision.
items.acceptance: An initiative cannot be activated without a linked hypothesis; report lists exceptions.

items.requirement: Problem maps MUST include symptom, causal hypothesis, audience, workaround, consequence, trigger, alternative, differentiator, evidence, counterevidence, and owner.
items.acceptance: Schema validation rejects a problem map missing required fields while permitting typed unknown values.

items.requirement: System MUST track current versions and states of existing MarketHypothesis, ProblemHypothesis, ICP, Campaign, Evidence, Asset, and Result rather than duplicate their authority.
items.acceptance: Entity map demonstrates stable existing IDs and no competing canonical records.

items.requirement: Opportunity prioritization MUST use explicitly defined criteria and expose evidence coverage and uncertainty separately from score.
items.acceptance: Two reviewers can explain a priority outcome from source-linked criterion values; unknown is not silently zero.

items.requirement: System MUST distinguish demand creation, demand capture, customer education, research, and promotional sales activity.
items.acceptance: Campaign records and reports expose explicit mode; shared campaigns can contain separately measured modes.

items.requirement: Commercial campaign approval MUST require buyer hypothesis, recognized symptom, plausible impact, identified buying trigger, evidence review, credible offer, and measurement plan.
items.acceptance: Attempted promotion with one missing gate remains in research/blocked state with reason.

items.requirement: Related initiatives MUST be represented as options for a shared problem without forcing a separate campaign for each product.
items.acceptance: One problem map can link EDF, Clarity, and HelixNote with role-specific distinctions and no duplicate journey required.

items.requirement: Priority decisions MUST be periodically reevaluated when contradictory research, offers, or conversion evidence arrives.
items.acceptance: A material disconfirming finding creates a review candidate with immutable earlier decision.

items.requirement: Research intake MUST preserve provenance, capture time, original observation, interpretation, support and contradiction classification.
items.acceptance: Given five findings, every one can be traced to an original source and claims remain separate from opinions.

items.requirement: Research plans MUST seek counterevidence and alternative explanations before advancing a problem hypothesis.
items.acceptance: Review cannot be approved without recorded counterevidence search or explicit no-results rationale.

items.requirement: Customer interviews MUST capture role, purchase involvement, recent concrete example, current workaround, severity, urgency, and authorization-safe notes.
items.acceptance: Structured interview template produces those fields, with declined/unavailable values preserved.

items.requirement: Customer-language snippets MUST be available as sourced quotation or paraphrase with authorization and handling metadata.
items.acceptance: Unsupported or non-consented quote cannot enter approved public claims.

items.requirement: Research MUST differentiate practitioner, sponsor, economic buyer, approver, and veto/influencer roles.
items.acceptance: A discovery record shows distinct persons/roles or explicit overlap and unknowns.

items.requirement: Evidence strength MUST distinguish attention, recognition, stated intent, behavioral commitment, buying activity, and paid action.
items.acceptance: A popular post cannot automatically be promoted into evidence of demand or revenue.

items.requirement: System SHOULD classify recurring normalized symptoms and maintain a frequency/segment map without claiming a representative sample from small studies.
items.acceptance: Report includes sample counts, sampling method, and limitation flag.

items.requirement: System MUST compare nonpurchase and competitor alternatives for each validated problem.
items.acceptance: A buyer report shows viable alternatives and recorded situations where Echelon is not recommended.

items.requirement: System SHOULD support structured coding of problem severity and trigger timing without overriding researcher judgment.
items.acceptance: Codebook version and reviewer edits are preserved for each categorized conversation.

items.requirement: Research findings SHOULD drive proposed product positioning and roadmap changes through versioned recommendations.
items.acceptance: Recommendation identifies supporting/contrary evidence and affected requirement or initiative.

items.requirement: Every approved demand-creation campaign MUST describe an observable entry symptom in customer's own language before describing product features.
items.acceptance: Reviewer sees problem-first entry asset with no feature-dependent opening statement.

items.requirement: A recognition journey MUST define ordered stages Recognition, Consequence, Possibility, Proof, Action, and Learning.
items.acceptance: Journey validator rejects missing stage and displays its intended evidence/action.

items.requirement: Each stage MUST serve a distinct customer question and connect to a relevant next step or a legitimate exit.
items.acceptance: Usability test can complete journey or leave without forced product pitch.

items.requirement: Recognition assets MUST disclose when scenarios are composites or illustrative rather than actual customer outcomes.
items.acceptance: Publishing gate flags a case study without verifiable provenance or illustration label.

items.requirement: Journeys MUST support practitioner, executive, and cross-functional approver perspectives without contradictory claims.
items.acceptance: Same problem map renders appropriate evidence for each role with consistent source data.

items.requirement: Every journey SHOULD include a usable independent action or lesson that remains valuable without buying.
items.acceptance: Pilot users can identify at least one actionable insight without surrendering contact information.

items.requirement: System SHOULD support sharing educational artifacts across channels while tracking source version and permissible claims.
items.acceptance: Derived posts map to approved canonical narrative and list material edits.

items.requirement: Cross-initiative next steps MUST be driven by diagnosed conditions rather than indiscriminate cross-sell.
items.acceptance: A diagnostic finding unrelated to HelixNote does not recommend HelixNote.

items.requirement: System MAY support multilingual customer-language variants after evidence of channel demand.
items.acceptance: Variant claims remain traceable to source and human review of meaning.

items.requirement: An impact model MUST distinguish measured, observed, calculated, estimated, and unavailable inputs.
items.acceptance: Report labels each parameter with type, units, origin, and date.

items.requirement: Missing cost, probability, severity or baseline data MUST remain unknown and MUST NOT default to zero.
items.acceptance: Tests with missing inputs produce unavailable/range-needed, not a misleading numeric ROI.

items.requirement: Impact estimates MUST show method, assumptions, uncertainty, and sensitivity to material inputs.
items.acceptance: Changing a key assumption visibly changes interval or outcome and report exposes formula version.

items.requirement: Every diagnostic report MUST separate possible correlation from causal attribution.
items.acceptance: Report cannot claim time savings caused by a product from before/after alone.

items.requirement: System SHOULD support role-relevant consequence categories including rework, defects, delivery delay, risk, turnover, and foregone opportunities.
items.acceptance: One problem can report relevant categories without double counting the same loss.

items.requirement: Business cases MUST compare at least doing nothing, process change, existing tooling, and Echelon offer where feasible.
items.acceptance: Comparison labels unknown results and excludes inapplicable options with rationale.

items.requirement: Public quantified claims MUST be backed by versioned evidence and approval scoped to their specific wording and context.
items.acceptance: An edited public claim cannot publish based on an approval of older wording.

items.requirement: System MAY calibrate cost-model error against customer-observed outcomes without revealing sensitive client inputs.
items.acceptance: Calibration shows error distribution and anonymization controls.

items.requirement: Pilot campaigns MUST offer a short self-assessment or demonstrator with clearly documented intended use and limitations.
items.acceptance: Each pilot has an accessible artifact delivering actionable results without requiring a sales meeting.

items.requirement: Diagnostic scoring MUST be versioned, explainable, reproducible, and tested against published fixtures.
items.acceptance: Given same inputs and version, scores and explanations match golden results.

items.requirement: A diagnostic MUST support unknown, prefer-not-to-answer, and insufficient-evidence outcomes instead of inventing precision.
items.acceptance: Sparse answers yield limited conclusions and display missing evidence needs.

items.requirement: Ungated diagnostic use MUST be possible unless individualized follow-up genuinely requires contact data.
items.acceptance: An anonymous visitor can complete the basic self-check and view results.

items.requirement: A diagnostic result MUST display strengths, suspected risks, suggested validation, alternative remedies, and relevant next step.
items.acceptance: Result report includes these sections and distinguishes suspicion from confirmed failure.

items.requirement: Interactive assets MUST work on mobile, keyboard, screen reader, and reduced-motion settings following Forma guidance.
items.acceptance: Automated and manual accessibility verification covers all pilot diagnostics.

items.requirement: Printable diagnostic and executive briefs MUST use Folio and remain legible across supported page sizes.
items.acceptance: PDF/print fixture tests show no clipped charts, headings, or missing source notes.

items.requirement: Demo examples MUST not expose real customer data and MUST clearly identify synthetic input.
items.acceptance: Privacy review and fixture tests show demo artifacts use approved fictional examples.

items.requirement: Diagnostics SHOULD be extensible to future initiatives through registered problem definitions rather than per-product forks.
items.acceptance: A fourth diagnostic can be added through manifest and reused components.

items.requirement: Every campaign experiment MUST preregister hypothesis, audience, comparator, assignment, success metric, measurement window and stopping rule.
items.acceptance: No experiment may enter running state while required preregistration fields are absent.

items.requirement: Pilots MUST compare problem-first messaging with a suitable product/service-led comparator where ethically and operationally practical.
items.acceptance: Pilot design documents both variants and controlled differences, or reason comparison is unavailable.

items.requirement: Experiments MUST preserve exposure denominators, qualified visitors, conversion events, and eligibility definitions.
items.acceptance: Analysis can reproduce conversion measures from captured event records.

items.requirement: System MUST warn against interpreting sparse, selected, or nonrandom samples as causal proof.
items.acceptance: A low-volume nonrandom campaign yields descriptive findings and limitation text.

items.requirement: Experiment review MUST report both supporting and disconfirming outcomes, objections, and unexpected segments.
items.acceptance: Outcome record includes failure cases and does not discard nonconverters.

items.requirement: Experiments MUST have explicit stop, refine, continue, and scale decisions supported by evidence and human authorization.
items.acceptance: At end-of-window, workflow produces a decision candidate with traceable basis.

items.requirement: When multiple versions exist, the system SHOULD record change history and avoid untracked mid-test edits.
items.acceptance: Changing copy after start creates new variant/version and preserves prior assignment.

items.requirement: System MAY estimate incremental commercial lift with appropriate experiment design and honest uncertainty bounds.
items.acceptance: Analysis states design assumptions and declines causal claim when violated.

items.requirement: Each channel MUST declare authorized account, permissions, content policy, rate limits, audience, and escalation owner.
items.acceptance: Unknown channel cannot publish or access credentials by default.

items.requirement: Public publishing and prospect outreach MUST require scoped human approval by channel, audience, asset version and action volume.
items.acceptance: Unapproved publish or send action is rejected and logged.

items.requirement: LinkedIn, Reddit, Facebook and X integrations MUST respect platform rules and use supported access methods; unavailable permissions MUST remain blocked.
items.acceptance: Adapter without approved access provides draft/export-only workflow, not workaround scraping.

items.requirement: System SHOULD support approved educational participation as distinct from promotional posting and outreach.
items.acceptance: Editorial plan records community benefit and prohibits generic unsolicited mass posting.

items.requirement: Each distributed asset MUST retain canonical narrative ID, variant, channel, timestamp and source URL where available.
items.acceptance: Campaign analytics trace a LinkedIn post to the original approved claim package.

items.requirement: Outreach MUST enforce recipient suppression, consent/legitimate basis policies, opt-out and deduplication.
items.acceptance: Suppressed contact cannot be contacted from a different campaign.

items.requirement: Channel selection MUST be hypothesis-led, not blanket distribution to every supported platform.
items.acceptance: Campaign plan states why the target decision maker is reachable through each chosen channel.

items.requirement: Distribution SHOULD support agent-prepared drafts with a human approval queue and content diff.
items.acceptance: Reviewer can approve, reject, request edits or expire authorization without publishing.

items.requirement: Every journey MUST have a relevant action offer, from no-cost assessment to scoped paid diagnostic, with clear expected effort and outcome.
items.acceptance: Landing page makes next step and its obligations understandable before contact details.

items.requirement: CRM and prospect records MUST distinguish anonymous interest, awareness gain, contact consent, qualified conversation, and active sales opportunity.
items.acceptance: A diagnostic completion without contact consent never creates a contactable lead automatically.

items.requirement: Qualification MUST capture problem ownership, urgency, economic impact hypothesis, buyer/approver access, and feasible next step.
items.acceptance: A qualified conversation record contains required fields or explicit unknowns.

items.requirement: Offers MUST include bounded scope, deliverables, exclusions, confidentiality, commercial terms, and success criteria.
items.acceptance: A paid diagnostic template can be completed and reviewed without inventing client terms.

items.requirement: System SHOULD capture objection taxonomy, reasons for loss, no-decision and alternative chosen.
items.acceptance: Analysis can distinguish lack of recognized need from lack of budget or solution fit.

items.requirement: System MAY generate tailored buying-group briefs using approved evidence only.
items.acceptance: Generated executive/finance/procurement versions preserve same underlying claims.

items.requirement: Success metrics MUST distinguish distribution, problem recognition, perceived relevance, commercial intent, revenue, and profitability.
items.acceptance: Reporting never shows reach as if it were verified commercial demand.

items.requirement: Recognition measurement SHOULD include a before/after or suitable comparator rather than treating clicks as awareness change.
items.acceptance: Pilot collects or explicitly marks unavailable an evidence-backed recognition measure.

items.requirement: Event records MUST carry campaign ID, problem ID, channel, variant, timestamp, consent basis where relevant, and data quality.
items.acceptance: Sample journey can be traced from exposure to qualified action when consent permits.

items.requirement: Attribution MUST support unattributed and multi-touch paths and MUST not falsely claim causal attribution.
items.acceptance: Organic/direct/unknown conversions remain visible and attributed totals do not exceed eligible events.

items.requirement: A decision dashboard MUST show uncertainty, evidence coverage, funnel conversion, acquisition effort, objections and commercial outcomes.
items.acceptance: An initiative with no opportunities displays zero observed opportunities and measurement coverage.

items.requirement: System MUST separate observed results from forecast and modeled estimates in all executive reports.
items.acceptance: Dashboards and exports visibly label actuals, estimates and unavailable data.

items.requirement: The learning loop MUST update hypothesis and priority proposals without silently promoting them to accepted truth.
items.acceptance: New results trigger review state; older decisions and supporting evidence remain preserved.

items.requirement: System SHOULD report cohorts and time lags so slow B2B purchasing cycles are not misread as immediate failure.
items.acceptance: Quarterly results indicate age of cohort and pending outcomes rather than automatic zero conversion.

items.requirement: Each requirement MUST retain stable identity, priority, intended behavior, acceptance, source strategy section, and dependencies.
items.acceptance: Praxis import/reconciliation can preserve IDs without conflating requirement and work item.

items.requirement: New features MUST reuse existing Marketing OS hypotheses, evidence, campaigns, approvals, and learning entities where equivalent.
items.acceptance: Implementation design documents reuse map before proposing schema additions.

items.requirement: Ordo-controlled legal states and guarded transitions MUST protect campaign approval and measurement integrity where deployed.
items.acceptance: Direct invalid transition attempt is rejected without partial persisted effects.

items.requirement: Praxis intake MUST preserve provenance, requirement IDs, decisions, work-item relationships, implementation tests and acceptance evidence.
items.acceptance: A requirement can be traced end-to-end without a GitHub issue being mistaken for canonical requirement source.

items.requirement: Interactive browser implementations MUST use pinned Forma components and the approved Limen/browser boundary when applicable.
items.acceptance: Tests detect release-pin drift and show components are actually used.

items.requirement: Printable reports MUST use pinned Folio; unexpected integration failures MUST use Aegis, not domain-state error aliases.
items.acceptance: Integration tests cover printable report and a redacted Aegis fault at API/storage boundary.

items.requirement: Implementations SHOULD be static-first and GitHub Pages compatible when feasible; backend dependencies require explicit justification.
items.acceptance: Pilot build runs locally and deploys without mandatory Kubernetes or unreviewed hosted services.

items.requirement: Fides and Arca integration MUST remain optional until verified as supported, with explicit provider-neutral contracts.
items.acceptance: Feature can run in approved test environment without assuming production Fides/Arca availability.

items.requirement: External content and collected data MUST be treated as untrusted, with sanitization, injection defenses and redacted telemetry.
items.acceptance: Adversarial source content cannot alter agent permissions or expose credentials.

items.requirement: Rules for agents MUST define permitted tools, inputs, outputs, approval gates, escalation, and no-send defaults.
items.acceptance: Agent attempting external post without authorization is denied and auditable.

items.requirement: Diagnostic and prospect collection MUST minimize personal information and distinguish anonymous from identified flows.
items.acceptance: Anonymous run creates no contact identity; personal data fields have documented necessity.

items.requirement: Retention, deletion, access control, and legal basis/consent MUST be specified before storing personal diagnostic responses or prospect data.
items.acceptance: Data removal request can find and delete or legally retain records with stated rationale.

items.requirement: All public claims MUST pass a claim-substantiation review; fabricated testimonials, false urgency and invented benchmarks are prohibited.
items.acceptance: Test case with synthetic success story cannot be released as real case study.

items.requirement: Diagnostics MUST document limitations, failure modes and inappropriate applications, and provide readable explanations.
items.acceptance: Result includes why score may be wrong and next verification steps.

items.requirement: Usability and accessibility MUST be validated on supported browser/device classes before launch.
items.acceptance: Keyboard/mobile/screen-reader/reduced-motion smoke tests pass for each new visitor journey.

items.requirement: Reports MUST avoid unverified causal claims, over-precise ROI, manipulative nudges or product-only outcomes.
items.acceptance: Automated policy checks flag risky wording and human reviewer records resolution.

items.requirement: Operational dashboards MUST show broken instrumentation, sample-selection issues and missing events.
items.acceptance: Zero conversions can be distinguished from missing tracking.

items.requirement: System MUST have a tested campaign rollback / publishing stop path for inaccurate claims or unauthorized content.
items.acceptance: Reviewer can stop delivery, withdraw approved variants and preserve incident audit trail.

items.requirement: Continuous validation SHOULD detect changed platform policies or diagnostic model versions requiring reevaluation.
items.acceptance: Material change creates review work and blocks unsafe automatic continuation.
